title: Boston criteria v2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy
scopeNote: MRI criteria for sporadic CAA (Boston v2.0): categories, lesion definitions and cut-offs, and accuracy against autopsy. ICH cause workup, CAA-related inflammation and antithrombotic decisions live in their own entries.

rows.target: Age ≥50 presenting with spontaneous ICH, TFNE, or cognitive impairment/dementia
evidenceNote: Charidimou 2022 Panel (p.720): diagnostic criteria, not a graded recommendation
sources: Charidimou A, et al. The Boston criteria version 2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy: a multicentre, retrospective, MRI-neuropathology diagnostic accuracy study. Lancet Neurol 2022;21(8):714-725. doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(22)00208-3

rows.target: ≥2 strictly lobar hemorrhagic lesions on T2* MRI in any combination (ICH, microbleed, cSS/cSAH foci), OR 1 lobar hemorrhagic lesion + 1 white matter feature (severe CSO-PVS or WMH multispot)
evidenceNote: Charidimou 2022 Panel (p.720): diagnostic criteria, not a graded recommendation
sources: Charidimou A, et al. The Boston criteria version 2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy: a multicentre, retrospective, MRI-neuropathology diagnostic accuracy study. Lancet Neurol 2022;21(8):714-725. doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(22)00208-3

rows.target: 1 strictly lobar hemorrhagic lesion on T2* MRI (ICH, microbleed, cSS/cSAH focus), OR 1 white matter feature (severe CSO-PVS or WMH multispot)
evidenceNote: Charidimou 2022 Panel (p.720): diagnostic criteria, not a graded recommendation

rows.target: No deep hemorrhagic lesion (ICH, microbleed) on T2* MRI; no other cause of hemorrhagic lesions
notes: Other causes: antecedent head trauma, hemorrhagic transformation of an ischemic stroke, AVM, hemorrhagic tumor, CNS vasculitis
Cerebellar hemorrhagic lesions count as neither lobar nor deep
Other causes of cSS and acute cSAH should also be excluded
evidenceNote: Charidimou 2022 Panel and footnote (p.720): diagnostic criteria, not a graded recommendation
sources: Charidimou A, et al. The Boston criteria version 2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy: a multicentre, retrospective, MRI-neuropathology diagnostic accuracy study. Lancet Neurol 2022;21(8):714-725. doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(22)00208-3

rows.condition: Autopsy, evacuated hematoma or cortical biopsy
rows.target: Definite CAA: full post-mortem showing severe CAA with vasculopathy. Probable CAA with supporting pathology: some degree of CAA in an evacuated hematoma or cortical biopsy
notes: Both: presentation with spontaneous ICH, TFNE, cSAH, or cognitive impairment/dementia; absence of other diagnostic lesion
Both categories retained unchanged in v2.0 (Methods, p.717)
evidenceNote: Charidimou 2022 Panel (p.720): diagnostic criteria, not a graded recommendation
sources: Charidimou A, et al. The Boston criteria version 2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy: a multicentre, retrospective, MRI-neuropathology diagnostic accuracy study. Lancet Neurol 2022;21(8):714-725. doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(22)00208-3

rows.target: >20 visible perivascular spaces in the centrum semiovale of one hemisphere
evidenceNote: Charidimou 2022 Figure 1 (p.717) and Methods, Procedures (p.716): definition, not graded
sources: Charidimou A, et al. The Boston criteria version 2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy: a multicentre, retrospective, MRI-neuropathology diagnostic accuracy study. Lancet Neurol 2022;21(8):714-725. doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(22)00208-3

rows.target: >10 small circular or ovoid T2/FLAIR-hyperintense lesions in the subcortical white matter of both hemispheres
notes: Less widely studied than CSO-PVS and may be less robust; needs independent replication (Discussion, p.723)
Periventricular and deep WMH severity was not associated with CAA (Results, p.718)
evidenceNote: Charidimou 2022 Figure 1 (p.717) and Methods, Procedures (p.716): definition, not graded
sources: Charidimou A, et al. The Boston criteria version 2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy: a multicentre, retrospective, MRI-neuropathology diagnostic accuracy study. Lancet Neurol 2022;21(8):714-725. doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(22)00208-3

rows.target: cSS in gyri separated by uninvolved areas, or in ≥3 adjacent gyri
notes: Single focus: still one focus if it extends to an adjacent gyrus
cSS adjacent to a lobar ICH is not counted
Multifocal cSAH/cSS alone can meet probable CAA, without ICH or microbleeds
sources: Charidimou A, et al. The Boston criteria version 2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy: a multicentre, retrospective, MRI-neuropathology diagnostic accuracy study. Lancet Neurol 2022;21(8):714-725. doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(22)00208-3

rows.target: Acute cSAH connected to or close to cSS = 2 hemorrhagic markers (dissemination in time)
notes: cSAH and cSS are rated as equivalent markers: acute and chronic forms of the same process

pitfalls: Mixed lobar + deep hemorrhagic lesions are not addressed: only 36 such cases, too few to derive criteria
Not validated in iatrogenic or hereditary CAA, or in asymptomatic people
Derived almost entirely from white participants of European ancestry
Needs T2*-weighted (hemorrhagic lesions) and T2-weighted (perivascular spaces) MRI; accuracy appeared highest with SWI
Accuracy is likely overestimated: every case needed brain tissue (spectrum bias)
keyNumbers: Probable CAA: ≥2 strictly lobar hemorrhagic lesions on T2* MRI in any combination (ICH, microbleed, cSS/cSAH foci), OR 1 lobar hemorrhagic lesion + 1 white matter feature (severe CSO-PVS or WMH multispot)
Possible CAA: 1 strictly lobar hemorrhagic lesion on T2* MRI (ICH, microbleed, cSS/cSAH focus), OR 1 white matter feature (severe CSO-PVS or WMH multispot)
Severe CSO-PVS: >20 visible perivascular spaces in the centrum semiovale of one hemisphere
WMH multispot pattern: >10 small circular or ovoid T2/FLAIR-hyperintense lesions in the subcortical white matter of both hemispheres
Multifocal cSS: cSS in gyri separated by uninvolved areas, or in ≥3 adjacent gyri
sources: Charidimou A, et al. The Boston criteria version 2.0 for cerebral amyloid angiopathy: a multicentre, retrospective, MRI-neuropathology diagnostic accuracy study. Lancet Neurol 2022;21(8):714-725. doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(22)00208-3
